proposed.short: A round study in a tower. The werewolf sits at a desk in the middle, and there are doorways on both sides.
proposed.long: A round study in a tower. A tall shelf of books stands on the left. In the middle, the werewolf sits at a desk with a typewriter on it. A dark arched window is in the back wall, with a framed diploma and then a poster to its right. A red rug covers the floor. Dark doorways lead out on the left and on the right.

proposed.name: Laboratory
proposed.short: A laboratory full of machines. A big creature sits strapped into a chair on the right.
proposed.long: A laboratory full of machines. On the left stands a tall machine with dials and a switch, with a socket low on the wall beside it and a plug on the floor nearby.
